newsitem.title: USA: Rumors of bear comments from Cohen untrue - source.
newsitem.headline: Rumors of bear comments from Cohen untrue - source.

text.p: Market rumors that Abby Joseph Cohen, Goldman Sachs managing director and co-chairman of its investment policy committee, had turned negative on U.S. stocks were untrue, according to a Goldman source.
The source said Cohen had not made any recent comments about the market.
Cohen was unavailable for comment. A Goldman spokesman had no immediate comment.
